title: Drift and delayed label investigation
content: Changes in missingness, distributions, routes, latency or errors trigger investigation. They do not establish measured accuracy loss. With no valid labels report model quality as unknown. Evaluate revealed labels only after an exact record and release join with adequate support; synthetic arrival times and controlled regressed models must remain labelled synthetic.
check: Separate input/runtime drift from label-backed performance, inspect sample support and confirm record/release identities before drawing a quality conclusion.
